fusions.name: Carver's Portion
fusions.desc: A hooked blow that costs 4% of your maximum health and deals 9 damage, leaving the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You heal for 35% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Laid Table
fusions.desc: A sweep of chain that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt, and every ally gains 15% damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Bones for Broth
fusions.desc: Hooks every body within 9 tiles, up to 5, and drains it. Each one restores 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Course After Course
fusions.desc: Each enemy you kill builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack, 25% in all at 5 stacks. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
